meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 它会扫描项目文件,找出没有被其他代码引用的“死代码”。逐条用 LSP 工具确认确实没人用之后,按文件分组,派多个后台智能体并行删除并各自提交 git。最后再跑类型检查、测试与构建,确保没弄坏项目。
howto.when: 当用户提到“remove dead code”、“cleanup”或“remove unused”等与删除无用代码相关的指令时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目的死代码清理掉。
say.note: 触发全项目扫描并删除未使用代码。

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录里的无用代码。
say.note: 把扫描范围限定在该目录。

say.text: 删掉没用的函数 unusedFunc,但别动入口文件。
say.note: 按符号名定点清理,入口文件受保护。

howto.what_en: Claude scans the codebase for unused code, verifies candidates via LSP, then batches removals by file and delegates them to parallel agents that delete and commit. Finally runs typecheck, tests, build.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to remove unused code, for example saying 'remove dead code', 'cleanup', or 'remove unused'.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project.
say_en.note: Runs a full-project scan and removes unused code.

say_en.text: Only clean unused code in src/utils.
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory.

say_en.text: Remove the unused function unusedFunc, but keep entry points intact.
say_en.note: Targets one symbol; entry points are protected.
